title: Implementation Specialist
description:
About GovPilot :

GovPilot provides cloud-based software solutions to local governments, aiming to make our communities better places to live and work. As a mission-driven company, GovPilot is committed to creating impactful technology that serves the public good.

We are looking for team members who take pride in their work and seek to consistently improve themselves, their skills, and their knowledge. If this sounds like you-and the type of work environment where you’d thrive-we hope you’ll join us!

What We Offer:

• Competitive salary.

• Unlimited PTO.

• Flexible working hours and remote work options.

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.

• Professional development opportunities and learning budget.

• Home office and IT budget.

• Supportive team environment.

• The chance to work on innovative projects with cutting-edge technologies.

The Position:

The Implementation Specialist , part of the GovPilot Professional Services team, is responsible for leading end-to-end deployments of our SaaS applications across all areas of municipal government. Guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful adoption. Acting as both a project lead and product expert, you’ll collaborate closely with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into effective, scalable system solutions.

You will play a key role in ensuring each customer realizes measurable value from our platform while providing a seamless, high-quality onboarding experience. The Implementation Consultant acts as a strategic advisor, helping clients re-engineer their business processes to maximize the value of the GovPilot platform. You will tackle our most technically challenging or politically sensitive implementations

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead technically complex or sensitive implementations, often spanning multiple departments within a single municipality

• Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients re-engineer business processes to maximize the value of the platform

• Architect custom system solutions for unique client requirements that go beyond standard platform configurations

• Consult with clients on data strategy, advising on data cleansing and restructuring to ensure long-term platform health

• Oversee QA standards for data imports and system integrations on assigned implementations, delegating execution to L2/L2.5 Analysts while maintaining accountability for data integrity prior to go-live

• Design and lead executive and department-head-level training sessions focused on change management and platform adoption strategy

• Monitor project health across a portfolio of complex implementations, proactively managing scope, risks, and dependencies with minimal oversight

• Own the post-launch transition process in partnership with Customer Success, ensuring clients are positioned for long-term platform health and high adoption before handoff

• Partner with Sales during the pre-sales process to assess implementation feasibility, contribute to scoping conversations, and support RFP responses for prospective clients

• Partner with Product and Engineering to provide formal feedback on feature gaps discovered during complex deployments

• Drive the creation of industry-specific best practice playbooks for the Professional Services department

• Proactively identify and lead process improvement initiatives that elevate delivery standards and scalability across the Professional Services department

Required & Preferred Qualifications:

• 3-5 years of SaaS Implementation or Professional Services experience required

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred

• Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles required

• Experience analyzing complex data structures and translating client data logic into clear requirements for technical team members required

• Proficiency with tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforc

title: US Hourly
Sr. Technical GTM Enablement Specialist
description:
About Megaport
We’re not your typical tech company - and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.
 
Our Team Culture
We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here - collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
 
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role
The Senior Technical GTM Specialist acts as a technical authority within the Global GTM organisation, bridging our Megaport Network and Latitude.sh Compute and Storage platforms. This is a pivotal role in translating Megaport’s platform capabilities into clear, deployable architectures for our customers. This role bridges Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market teams by transforming complex multi-platform solutions into practical blueprints, technical enablement materials, and field-ready assets.
You will work at the intersection of deep technical expertise and customer-facing strategy, ensuring that highly sophisticated solutions - spanning connectivity, compute, storage, and emerging workloads - are articulated with precision and credibility. 
This role provides a high impact career path for experienced Solution Architects who want to shape global Technical GTM strategy, and build technical content (diagrams, guides, labs, battlecards etc) that help influence & close deals.
Instead of high-level collateral, you will create concrete technical blueprints, clean architecture diagrams, API integration guides, and hands-on lab environments.

#LI-DNI

If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at Careers@megaport.com
 
NOTE: All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team careers@megaport.com directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".
 
All applications will be treated in confidence.
Please see Part 2 of our Privacy Policy to see what information Megaport collects from job applicants, why, and how we store and use it. Note that you’re entitled to know what personal data of yours Megaport holds, to request updates, rectification, and in some circumstances restriction or deletion thereof if you object (you being entitled to withdraw your consent to our holding your information at any time). Please see Part 5 of our Privacy Policy for more details on this and how to contact Megaport's data protection officer if you have any further privacy-related questions. Candidates who meet the selection criteria will be invited to attend an interview. Strictly no Recruitment Agencies.

title: VP of Investments Asia
description:

Accial Capital is looking to hire a VP of Investments. The position is a great opportunity for a mid-senior professional to advance their career at the intersection of fintech, private credit, technology, and impact investing at an entrepreneurial fast-growing asset management firm. The VP will be instrumental in expanding deal origination and performing due diligence on Accial’s investment opportunities in Asia. The candidate is expected to significantly contribute to strengthening Accial’s impact framework.
About Accial Capital :
Accial Capital is a rapidly growing specialist asset management firm with deep experience in investing privately negotiated asset-backed loans to lenders and private enterprises in emerging markets. Accial Capital was founded in 2018 and deploys capital out of multiple funds in emerging markets. Accial has an enthusiastic and diverse team with a strong local presence in our target markets in Latin America and Asia, as well as team members based in Europe. We integrate our own industry-leading risk analytics and data management with deep credit underwriting experience and structuring skills to successfully execute our investment strategy.
At Accial Capital , we aspire to live in a world of rapidly improving access to responsible credit. By combining capital, credit expertise, data, and technology, we deliver superior risk-adjusted returns to our clients and make a positive difference for MSMEs and people's lives and livelihoods. Accial Capital is a signatory to the Responsible Finance Forum Investor Guidelines and is a member of the Global Impact Investing Network.

We are looking for a smart, driven professional to successfully originate investment opportunities and maintain relationships with existing portfolio companies. The successful candidate combines a deep understanding of fundamental credit analyses, impact investing, and structured credit, with strong quantitative affinity. The candidate will work on prospective new investments across multiple deal stages including deal sourcing, due diligence, structuring, and legal documentation. The candidate will also represent Accial Capital at conferences, industry events and other situations within the assigned region. This role will report to the CIO.

• Origination: Maintain and refine a deep knowledge of market participants and borrowers across Accial’s markets through which we will identify the next great set of lenders to add to the portfolio. Attend industry events and develop strategic partnerships with relevant actors in the space that can contribute to deal sourcing (i.e. venture capital firms, accelerators, industry associations, etc).

Closely work with our risk, legal, and technology teams to advance and close transactions. Negotiate terms and structure. Prepare and present investment memos to the Investment Committee. Follow relevant market and macroeconomic developments closely.

• Portfolio management: Assist risk team with ongoing portfolio management as needed.

• Train and upskill: Constantly refine and improve the Accial approach to private debt and impact. Coach team members.

• Experience: minimum of 5 years of relevant professional work experience in private credit or closely related field such as venture capital, private equity or investment banking. Demonstrated track record of successfully sourcing credit transactions in emerging markets strongly preferred.

title: Senior Software Engineer III, Email & Communications Platform
description:
Senior Software Engineer, Email & Communications Platform (Software Engineer III)
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team that owns our email and communications platform - the system responsible for delivering millions of marketing emails on behalf of our dealer network. You'll work across the full stack, building and scaling the infrastructure that powers campaigns, transactional messages, and automated communications that directly drive revenue for our customers.
This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership. Our platform is in an active modernization phase. You'll be working in a mature codebase that serves real production traffic while incrementally upgrading architecture, tooling, and patterns. That means you need to be comfortable holding two things at once: keeping the lights on for a system dealers depend on today, and making deliberate progress toward where the platform needs to be tomorrow. You'll design and implement features end-to-end, from database schema and API design through to the UI that internal teams and dealers interact with, while identifying opportunities to retire technical debt and modernize along the way.
You'll tackle challenges around deliverability, throughput, sender reputation, and compliance - problems where good engineering decisions have measurable business impact. You'll collaborate closely with product, deliverability specialists, and other engineering teams. We're a remote-first team that values clear communication, pragmatic technical decisions, and shipping work that matters.
Here is more of what you’ll get to do:

• Design, build, and maintain full-stack features across our email and communications platform

• Work on systems that handle email delivery at scale - sending infrastructure, queue management, throttling, bounce handling, and deliverability optimization

• Build and improve APIs, background services, and data pipelines in .NET

• Develop and maintain cloud-native services in Azure (Functions, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, SQL, Blob Storage, etc.)

• Drive modernization efforts - refactoring legacy code, migrating to modern patterns, and improving observability and testability in a production system

• Collaborate with product and stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-architected solutions

• Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and incident response

• Balance new feature development with incremental improvements to system reliability, maintainability, and developer experience

• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence

• 5-7 years of professional software engineering experience

• Full-stack development - comfortable owning features from backend to frontend

title: Claims Examiner - Bodily Injury
description:
By joining Sedgwick , you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies
Certified as a Great Place to Work®
Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance
Claims Examiner - Bodily Injury PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THE ROLE: To analyze and process complex bodily injury auto and commercial transportation claims by reviewing coverage, completing investigations, determining liability and evaluating the scope of damages.
ARE YOU AN IDEAL CANDIDATE?
To analyze complex auto bodily injury claims on behalf of our valued clients by evaluating coverage, investigating liability, and managing damages, while ensuring timely resolution within service expectations, industry best practices, and specific client requirements.
ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBLITIES MAY INCLUDE

• Processes complex auto commercial and personal line claims, including bodily injury and ensures claim files are properly documented and coded correctly.

• Responsible for litigation process on litigated claims.

• Coordinates vendor management, including the use of independent adjusters to assist the investigation of claims.

• Reports large claims to excess carrier(s).

• Develops and maintains action plans to ensure state required contact deadlines are met and to move the file towards prompt and appropriate resolution.

• Identifies and pursues subrogation and risk transfer opportunities; secures and disposes of salvage.

• Communicates claim action/processing with insured, client, and agent or broker when appropriate.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

• Supports the organization's quality program(s).

QUALIFICATIONS
Education & Licensing: Five (5) years of claims management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience required to include in-depth knowledge of personal and commercial line auto policies, coverage’s, principles, and laws.

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university preferred.

• Professional certification as applicable to line of business preferred.

• Skills: strong oral and written communication, including presentation skills, PC literate including Microsoft Office products, and ability to work in a team environment.

• Secure and maintain the State adjusting licenses as required for the position.

TAKING CARE OF YOU

• Flexible work schedule.

• Referral incentive program.

• Career development and promotional growth opportunities.

• A diverse and comprehensive benefits offering including medical, dental vision, 401K on day one.

Work environment requirements include -
Physical: Computer keyboarding
Auditory/visual: Hearing, vision and talking
Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgement and discretion; ability to meet deadlines.
As required by law, Sedgwick provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in jurisdictions requiring pay transparency in job postings. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and cost of specific location. For the jurisdiction noted in this job posting only, the range of starting pay for this role is $80,000 to $85,000 . A comprehensive benefits package is offered including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, 401k and matching, PTO, disability and life insurance, employee assistance, flexible spending or health savings account, and other additional voluntary benefits.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Facilities Management eXpress is looking for an Engineer Manager to join our team!
At FMX , our Engineering Managers have a direct impact on our product, our people, and our culture. As manager of a Core Team, you’ll coach and mentor a talented group of software engineers, give them clarity on priorities and expectations, and help them grow technically and professionally while delivering high-quality software for our customers. You’ll partner closely with product, design, QA, and other engineering leaders to align your team’s work with business goals and build a healthy, high-performing, inclusive engineering culture.
This is a player-coach role. We want a manager who still loves to build: someone who stays close to the code, picks up bugs and non-mission-critical work alongside the team, and leads by example. You’ll also help shape how FMX builds software in an AI-first world, setting the practices, tools, and standards that help our engineers ship faster without lowering the bar on quality.
What You’ll Do:

•
Lead and grow your team: Give every engineer clarity on their role, responsibilities, goals, and the team’s processes, and clearly communicate changes to practices, priorities, and expectations. Provide regular coaching, feedback, and career guidance, and advocate for each person’s professional and technical growth.

•
Build a strong culture: Foster trust, accountability, and continuous improvement, where engineers feel valued, heard, and connected to FMX ’s mission. Keep the team engaged with challenging, meaningful problems and help them see the customer impact of their work.

•
Clear the path: Actively remove blockers so the team works efficiently with minimal friction.

•
Stay technical: Keep a strong understanding of your team’s systems so you can guide architecture decisions and unblock engineers directly. Champion operational excellence, including observability, CI/CD health, and production readiness.

•
Drive AI-first development: Evaluate, adopt, and set standards for AI-assisted coding, code review, and testing tools.

•
Shape the bigger picture: Contribute to engineering leadership discussions, decisions, and process evolution; partner with product and design leads on priorities and long-term vision; and help hiring teams identify, recruit, and onboard top engineering talent.

Requirements
What we're looking for:

• 2-4 years of engineering management or technical leadership experience, and prior experience as a software engineer, ideally in SaaS.

• A builder’s mindset: you still enjoy writing code and will regularly contribute fixes, features, and triage work that isn’t mission-critical.

• Hands-on experience with AI-first development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, agentic workflows) and a point of view on best practices you can teach others.

• This role requires working Eastern Time hours to join daily team meetings, so candidates should be based in or able to work on Eastern Time.

• A proven ability to coach and grow engineers at every career stage, with strong, empathetic, and clear communication.

• Experience improving engineering processes and development workflows, plus familiarity with agile practices and cross-functional collaboration.

• The ability to think strategically while attending to the details of day-to-day execution.

• A passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams that value continuous learning and an excellent developer experience.

• Enthusiasm for FMX ’s mission and alignment with our core pillars: Teamwork, Excellence, and Integrity.

Nice to Have:

• Native mobile experience (Swift or Kotlin)

• Cloud infrastructure experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP)

• Infrastructure as code with Terraform

• Containerization with Docker

• CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance

• Observability (logging, metrics, traces, and alerting) or SIEM experience

Our Tech Stack:

• .NET / C#

• React and TypeScript

• React Native

• Azure

description:
Make a SPLASH with Latham, The Pool Company !

At Latham, The Pool Company , we don’t just make swimming pools; we create opportunities for backyard dreams to come true. As the leading manufacturer in North America, Australia, and New Zealand, we are committed to delivering innovation, quality, and sustainability in everything we do.

We believe in building an environment where everyone can thrive. That is why we offer:

• A culture of integrity, collaboration, and respect.

• Comprehensive benefits for you and your family.

• Opportunities for growth, mentorship, and skill development.

A little about the position:
Job Summary
The Business Development Manager (BDM), Sand States Fiberglass is a growth-focused field sales role responsible for creating measurable, profitable, incremental revenue for Latham’s Fiberglass Pools product category within an assigned geographic territory. The BDM will identify and convert new dealers, distributors, pool builders, installers, and other channel partners; expand category penetration in underdeveloped accounts and markets; and increase Fiberglass Pools sales across eligible Latham and competitive pool opportunities.
This role owns new-business opportunities from prospecting and qualification through proposal, first order, onboarding, activation, and repeat revenue. Success will be measured primarily by incremental net sales and gross margin above the established territory baseline, new-account productivity, qualified pipeline growth, conversion rate, Fiberglass Pools sales growth, and market-share gains. Existing-account service, technical support, and training are important enablers of growth but are secondary to the role’s primary new-business mandate.

title: Telehealth Vets: Florida
description:
US-based Independent Contractor Veterinarian with Vetster
Location: Remote in Florida
About Vetster

Vetster is revolutionizing pet healthcare by connecting pet owners with licensed veterinarians through our innovative digital platform. We provide convenient access to professional veterinary advice, diagnoses, and prescriptions, with a mission to make pet care accessible, affordable, and stress-free for every pet parent.
Join our Mission
Vetster is seeking Veterinarians licensed and in good standing in Florida to join our platform and provide virtual care on the side. This is an exciting opportunity to join our platform and a growing network of veterinarians at the forefront of telemedicine. As a flexible, independent contractor, you’ll have the freedom to create your own schedule and work as much or as little as you’d like.
Experience with exotic species (small mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, invertebrates) is a strong asset and a plus, helping us service our public partnership with PetSmart, but all levels are welcome, including vets who primarily see cats and dogs.
What You’ll Do:
As a Veterinarian licensed in Florida, you will:

• Conduct virtual video appointments with pet owners through the Vetster platform

• Provide thorough clinical assessments, triage guidance, and treatment recommendations within your scope of practice and applicable regulations

• Complete accurate and timely medical records for each appointment within the platform

• Deliver an exceptional client experience - communicating clearly, compassionately, and professionally

• Adhere to Vetster 's standards of care and platform policies

• Maintain compliance with your provincial licensing requirements

You're paid per appointment with additional supplementary earnings programs designed to reflect the flexible, on-your-own-schedule nature of the work.
What You Bring:

• You are a DVM/VMD licensed to practice veterinary medicine in the US in good standing, within the highlighted state
• Bonus points if you are licensed in multiple states.

• You have experience treating some or all of the following exotic species: guinea pigs, hamsters, mice, rabbits, lizards, turtles, snakes, tarantulas, scorpions, crabs, and birds

• You are passionate about Telemedicine with a genuine belief in the power of digital health to expand access to care

Ready to Make a Difference?
Embark on a fulfilling journey with us and shape the future of pet healthcare through design. If you're driven by innovation, collaboration, and a love for pets, we’d love to connect.

description:

title: Practice Director
description:
Director of Practice - Dragon Vets Salary up to £60,000 DOE Closing date: 2nd November Subject to change

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

We have a unique opportunity for a Director of Practice to lead our teams at Dragon Vets which is made up of our main hospital and 4 branches. You will work closely with the Lead Vet to shape the future of the practice.

Located in the heart of Cheltenham, renowned for horse racing and a thriving bar and restaurant scene, Dragon Vets is an established practice and has invested in specialist equipment including CT, DR, rigid and flexible endoscopy, high-end Doppler ultrasonography and well-equipped operating facilities including laparoscopic kits and TPLO kits, and much more.

Practice Highlights

We have a team of 16 vets, including certificate holders with Advanced Practitioner status in Small Animal Surgery, Cardiology and Medicine, and value evidence-based medicine with regular clinical discussions and readily available colleague support. We're also classed as a mid-tier referral centre.

We function as more than a first-opinion practice, often performing complex surgeries and treating intensive medical cases that may otherwise have been referred. Having been established for decades, we have a huge client base which comes with lots of variety in caseload.

We have a dedicated, separate out-of-hours team - Vets Now - based within the same building, enabling 24-hour care. Our nursing team is made up of 17 RVNs and 4 SVNs in various stages of their training.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer, Customer Memory.

About the job

This position is needed to build and scale the pipelines that turn raw conversation data into structured, searchable customer memory, and the evaluation systems that keep that memory accurate as the product evolves.

You'll join the Conversation Memory team, which builds the memory layer behind Twilio's Conversational AI platform: the systems that extract what matters from millions of conversations, resolve it to the right customer, and retrieve it in milliseconds when an agent needs it. Memory that is wrong, stale, or crossed between customers is worse than no memory at all, so quality measurement is a first-class part of the work.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

• Build the extraction pipeline that turns raw data into structured memory, tuning the LLM prompts and schemas that decide what an AI agent remembers about a customer and what it forgets.

• Contribute to the eval systems that tell us whether memory is actually getting better, turning a fuzzy question of quality into benchmarks and regression gates that run before every change ships.

• Diagnose production issues across the ingestion, extraction, and indexing path using logs, metrics, and traces.

• Partner with Product and ML teams to translate customer problems into system changes and evaluation criteria.

title: [US - DC] FSQ Area Manager

description:
Time commitment: Between 3-5 days per week (0.6-1 FTE) - our preference is for this to be an Employed position, but we will also consider Self-employed arrangements
Location: Remote
Reporting to: NeurodevelopmentalTeam Manager
About Paloma
In 2024, our founders, Mark and Darshak, were shocked to find that children needing an NHS autism or ADHD assessment were waiting 4-10 years for these assessments. Delayed assessments result in children being more likely to develop mental health conditions and fall behind in education. Furthermore, the much-needed pre/post-assessment support (outside of ADHD medications) is typically not funded by the NHS.
These long waits have built up due to increased recognition and understanding of neurodevelopmental conditions and a lack of investment and innovation within the NHS to meet the growing demand.
Mark and Darshak, with their 25 years of combined NHS experience, including building services that have treated over 1,000,000 patients in obesity & ophthalmology, founded Paloma to change this. Our mission is to make NHS autism and ADHD assessments and care accessible within 4 weeks of a GP referral, and, in turn, help every child achieve their potential.

• Taking a product-first approach to redesign the care pathway to give families a more consumer-like experience of care

At Flix, Customer Service actively transforms how we provide a service to our passengers while adopting frontier technologies. ZenDesk is one of the systems to be implemented after the pilot and you will own this. As a Senior Zendesk Administrator, you are the person who does the actual configuration work: you build the workflows, routing, and channel setup that hundreds of agents and millions of passengers will use every day.  

You sit inside the business team. You take business requirements from market and process owners, turn them into working Zendesk configuration yourself. You own what is shipped in production. You are comfortable being the most hands-on Zendesk person in the room.

• Platform configuration:  build and maintain the core Zendesk setup across Support, Guide, Talk, and Messaging: ticket fields and forms, groups, views, macros, triggers, automations, SLA policies, omnichannel routing, brands, and roles and permissions. You work in a sandbox-to-production model and keep the instance clean as it grows; config sprawl across 30 markets is a real risk and part of your job is preventing it.

• Channel setup:  configure Voice (Zendesk Talk on Amazon Connect, including IVR and contact flows), email, webform, messaging, and Help Center for each market, in the local language, working from the global blueprint and adapting it where market-specific rules genuinely require it.

• Collaboration:  work daily with business SMEs who own rules and processes, the training lead who prepares agents for each go-live, IT engineering who owns integrations and security, and the project lead who owns the rollout plan.

• Documentation:  document all configuration and market-specific deviations to Centre of Excellence standards, so nothing you build depends on you being in the room.

About You

• Zendesk experience:  5+ years hands-on administering and configuring Zendesk in production (we care about proven delivery), on Enterprise plans: triggers, automations, macros, SLA policies, ticket forms, custom fields and objects, and omnichannel routing. You understand trigger firing order, know how to prevent loops, and can explain why a tag taxonomy matters. Zendesk Admin certification is a plus.

Anyscale's security needs are growing as we operate more production and cloud infrastructure for larger and more demanding customers. NICE TO HAVE

- Familiarity with Upwind or similar CSPM and runt

title: Sr Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Sr. Analyst, FP&A
The FP&A team’s mission is to deliver data-driven financial and operational analyses that inform strategic decision-making, business planning, and areas of future investment. This individual will be responsible for all FP&A activities within their business area, and the FP&A team structure allows for future opportunities to cover other Evolent business lines and operations over time.
Evolent ’s FP&A team works cross-functionally with all departments across the organization, including Operations, Accounting, Implementation, and Sales, and partners with all company stakeholders, including the executive leadership team.
What You Will Be Doing:

The primary responsibilities of the Sr. Analyst include assisting in the following FP&A activities for their business area:
Supporting their Business Area in all FP&A Activities -

• Produce monthly financial packages / reports with business intelligence / KPIs with commentary on key business drivers

• Report out to the FP&A team on recent financial performance and trends for their business area during monthly meetings and in any other forums

• Conduct ad hoc analysis and data requests including highlighting unexpected variances / trends and engaging business leaders to jointly investigate these items

• Coordinate with business leaders in forecasting and budgeting processes, highlighting areas of opportunity, and soliciting the department’s input on key business driver assumptions

• Assist department leaders in all areas within FP&A and all other ancillary Finance functions (e.g., reporting, coordinating with Accounting / Payroll, job requisitions / open role planning, department P&L forecasting)

• Customize the standard companywide FP&A tools to aid the unique needs of the business area

• Provide both business updates and process recommendations to the Finance team informed by challenges and opportunities within that business area

• Liaise with other teams under the Finance umbrella (e.g., Actuarial, Accounting) to maintain accurate forecasting

Responsibility for Core FP&A Activities -

• Primary point of contact for your business area

• Build and maintain forecast models with consistency, accuracy, and scalability

• Continuously seek to improve our financial models as the business evolves and the customer base and product offerings expand

• Provide nuanced analysis to help explain monthly variances and impacts to future forecasts

• Publish an annual budget and a monthly forecast with bridges vs. prior forecasts

• Create, automate, and maintain financial reporting tools

• Partner with the Accounting team to investigate variances vs. forecast

• Collaborate with the Financial Information Systems team to drive Adaptive Insights functionality improvement, including automating reporting and developing process automation initiatives

• Manage Workday / Adaptive financial data in partnership with Talent, Workday, and Finance (e.g., project codes, capitalization codes, cost centers)

Qualifications Required and Preferred:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience - required

• 3+ years of FP&A experience

title: Senior Product Manager: Extensible Compute
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER: EXTENSIBLE COMPUTE

Location: MPK or Bellevue |
Workplace: Hybrid

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don't just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset, rapidly testing emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager for our Extensible Compute team, which builds Snowpark Container Services (SPCS). SPCS is the compute platform that runs customer container workloads and Snowflake's own first-party products, including Openflow, Notebooks, Streamlit, and AI agents. You will own the product for that platform: which compute we offer, how reliably and cheaply it runs, and how partner teams and customers get what they need without a one-off every time.

AS A SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Own the SPCS product roadmap and ship it. That includes the compute instance portfolio across AWS, Azure, and GCP (general-purpose CPU, ARM, and GPU, including new Nvidia generations), and the storage and file system capabilities workloads depend on.

- Turn requests from first-party product partners into platform capabilities. When Openflow, Notebooks, Streamlit, or an agent team needs a new instance, a networking change, or multi-cluster support, you decide what becomes a standard SPCS feature and what stays a one-off.

- Take features from early preview to general availability. You set the launch bar, hold a release when security, reliability, or unit economics are not ready, and work the path through PrPr and PuPr with engineering. Work credibly with senior engineers on architecture, performance, reliability, and cost.

- Own platform health that customers feel: startup time, isolation, storage reliability, and the unit economics of running a workload on SPCS. You partner with Finance on pricing ($/GiB, instance pricing) when the model has to change.

- Be the product point of contact for our infrastructure partners (AWS, Azure, GCP, Nvidia) on the SPCS compute roadmap, and for account teams qualifying strategic customers onto SPCS.

- Use AI as part of how you work: customer and partner synthesis, specs, launch reviews, and the analysis behind a prioritization call.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER WILL HAVE:

- 5+ years of product management experience, including several years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing product, or equivalent experience owning a technical product end to end.

- Hands-on depth in at least one of: cloud infrastructure

description:
Raphael & Associates is a globally recognized third-party claims administrator and independent claims adjusting firm, known for delivering exceptional service. We understand the importance of staying agile in a dynamic market and pride ourselves on tailoring our solutions to meet the unique needs of each client. While the work we do as a claims organization is complex, our mission is clear: to deliver outstanding service, attract and retain top-tier professionals, and leverage industry-leading technology to drive results.

Join Our Team
As a leader in the industry, we offer dynamic and rewarding career opportunities for individuals who are driven to make an impact. Our culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to excellence. We value professionals who bring creativity, vision, and a proactive, results-oriented mindset.
We are seeking experienced, motivated, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team and contribute to our continued success.

The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Complex Liability Claims Adjuster to manage high-exposure general liability and excess liability claims involving significant financial exposure, complex coverage issues, and litigation. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and negotiation skills, advanced coverage expertise, and the ability to effectively manage claims through resolution while partnering with defense counsel, insureds, brokers, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Investigate, evaluate, and resolve complex General Liability and Excess Liability claims, including high-exposure bodily injury, property damage, catastrophic losses, and litigated matters.

• Analyze coverage, liability, damages, and exposure to develop effective claim strategies.

• Establish, maintain, and adjust reserves in accordance with company guidelines and best practices.

• Manage litigated claims in partnership with defense counsel, including oversight of pleadings, discovery, motion practice, mediation, and trial preparation.

• Review medical records, expert reports, and damage evaluations to assess claim exposure.

• Negotiate settlements within authority and provide recommendations on high-value claims.

• Maintain accurate, timely, and well-documented claim files.

• Communicate effectively with insureds, claimants, attorneys, brokers, and internal business partners.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, company standards, and service expectations.

Qualifications

• 7-10+ years of experience handling complex, high-exposure General Liability and/or Excess Liability claims.

• Active Resident State Licensing or Active Non-Resident State Licensing and an active New York Adjuster license required.

• Demonstrated experience managing litigated casualty claims from inception through resolution.

• Strong knowledge of liability coverage, tort law, and claims handling best practices.

• Excellent negotiation, analytical, and decision-making skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication abilities.

• Ability to independently manage a complex caseload in a fast-paced environment.

• Proficiency with claims management systems and Microsoft Office Suite.

We are an organization that values and recognizes the contributions of our team members. title: People Operations Manager (Antwerp)
description:
ABOUT CONVEO

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, product, and research teams.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/49c7399e-a401-4987-ab34-2ca5e18d2f29/3519e886-495e-4d41-8a3b-439b2a607aea/pictures.jpg]

THE CONTEXT

Conveo is scaling from $4M to $50M, and the People team is running on goodwill and late nights. We have a recruiting team and a new L&D hire joining, but nobody owns the processes and systems underneath them. Compensation schemes, performance cycles and salary reviews all land on Claudia, alongside the daily operational load.

That has to change before we grow further. You'll be the first dedicated People Operations hire, reporting to Claudia. You'll build the operating system for the whole People function: the tools, data, cycles and lifecycle processes that let us hire, pay, develop and support people well across the UK, Belgium and the US.

You'll work closely with Finance on payroll and compensation, with recruiting and L&D on the employee lifecycle, and with managers across the company. When you've done this well, Claudia spends her time on strategy and growing the team, not on firefighting.

YOUR MISSION

1. OWN THE PEOPLE SYSTEMS STACK AND MAKE IT WORK ACROSS EVERY COUNTRY

You decide how our People tools fit together, then make them run. Today that spans an HRIS, EOR and PEO providers, and payroll across several geographies.

- Own the HRIS as the single source of truth for every employee, contractor and EOR hire

- Lead a possible payroll migration end to end: vendor choice, data cleanup, parallel runs, cutover

- Manage EOR and PEO relationships across the UK, Belgium and the US

- Connect systems so data flows once, not through spreadsheets and copy-paste

- Use AI and automation to remove manual admin wherever it adds no judgement

2. BUILD AN EMPLOYEE LIFECYCLE THAT FEELS EFFORTLESS AT 2X OUR SIZE

Every hire, move and exit should follow a clear, repeatable path that works in any country we operate in.

- Design onboarding, internal moves and offboarding flows with recruiting and L&D

- Turn tribal knowledge into documented processes and self-serve answers

- Keep contracts, documents and policies consistent across geographies

- Make the experience good for employees and managers, not just compliant

3. RUN THE PEOPLE CYCLES THE COMPANY DEPENDS ON

Performance reviews, compensation and salary increases should run on time, every time, without pulling Claudia into the detail.

- Own the performance cycle calendar, tooling and manager enablement

- Run compensation projects and salary review cycles with Claudia and Finance

- Keep bands, levels and approvals applied consistently

- Spot what slowed each cycle down and fix it before the next one

4. TURN PEOPLE DATA INTO DECISIONS

Leadership should be able to answer people questions in minutes, with numbers they trust.

- Build reliable reporting on headcount, attrition, compensation and cycle completion

- Keep People data clean enough to support planning and board reporting

- Give Claudia and managers the insight to act early, not after the fact

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

MUST-HAVES

- 5+ years in People Operations, including time at a startup or scaleup through hypergrowth, with hands-on experience across multiple countries (ideally Belgium and the UK)

- Hands-on experience scaling a People function: you've seen what breaks between 50 and 200+ people and helped fix it

- Strong systems thinking: you design processes and tool stacks that hold up as the company grows, not one-off fixes

- Hands-on experience implementing an HRIS (Deel is a big plus) and running at least one people cycle (performance, comp review or onboarding) end to end.

- Comfort working with data: you can build a report leadership trusts, and you notice when the numbers look wrong

title: Product Engineer (AI Team)
description:
About Us

Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before.

We are the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals health than ever.

The traction speaks for itself: one of Europe's top 100 AI startups with a team of over 80 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 3M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London.

AI is not a side project here. Jerry, our AI teammate for vets, launches this month with clinical decision support, a listening mode for live consults, and hands-free voice next. You will ship weekly to real clinics and see the impact directly.

In this role, you will:

- Build Jerry's clinical guideline library: RAG over vet-approved guidelines using hybrid vector and keyword search in Postgres, so Jerry answers clinical questions only from approved sources and cites the exact lines it used

- Build Jerry's listening mode: a fast classifier that watches live consult transcripts and triggers Jerry to surface missed charges, tests, or risks in real time

- Build Jerry's voice mode: a hands-free, voice-first experience for ambulatory vets on the road, where everything is spoken and any change waits for the vet's approval

- Build long-running and scheduled Jerry tasks: turns that keep running after the vet closes the tab, and scheduled jobs that prepare drafts for the vet to approve

- Own what you build in production across the TypeScript server and Python AI service: deploys, monitoring, fixes, weekly releases, and a share of on-call

- Be a trusted reviewer on AI pull requests and write the design docs for new AI features

Your background looks something like:

- 4+ years of professional software engineering, including at least a year shipping LLM features to real users in production

- TypeScript in production (Node.js backend and React) and Python in production (FastAPI or similar)

- Has built with LLM APIs in production: tool calling and agent loops, structured output, prompt and model iteration

- Deploys and owns code in production: CI/CD, Docker, a cloud platform (AWS ideally), monitoring and fixing live issues

- SQL and Postgres, with git fluency across branches, rebasing, pull requests, and code review

- RAG experience: embeddings, hybrid vector and keyword search (pgvector), reranking, citations (nice to have · the first project)

- Voice AI experience: real-time voice agents, speech-to-text, telephony integration (nice to have)

- Works well with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) and reviews their output critically

As a person, you:

- Are a product engineer first · you care about what ships and how it performs in front of real users, not just whether it works in a test environment

- Own your code end to end, from design doc to production, and do not consider a feature done until it is monitored and stable

- Can explain the code you wrote, including the code your AI tools wrote for you

- Are comfortable in a small team with a big scope, working directly alongside vets, product, and the wider engineering org

- Are excited to work from our London WeWork office most of the week

- Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic

What does success look like in 6 months?

- Shipping to production every week and contributing to on-call

- Jerry's guideline library v1 is live for pilot clinics: it answers only from approved guidelines, cites exact lines, and passes the clinical team's test questions

- Listening mode is piloted with at least one clinic, with every suggestion tracked to show the revenue it reco

title: GTM Onboarding Lead
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We're hiring a GTM Onboarding Lead to own Global Onboarding within GTM Enablement. Harvey is hiring go-to-market talent faster than at any point in its history, and in 2027 the GTM organization will more than double across AMER, EMEA and APAC. Every one of those hires goes through onboarding. The program runs well in the US, is up and running in London and is about to launch in Sydney. This person will turn it into one global system, built for a hiring volume very few companies have had to onboard.

You will own role-specific ramp tracks, bootcamp cohorts, milestone certifications, 30/60/90 frameworks, ramp measurement, the LMS and content system, and the everboarding curriculum that keeps tenured reps current. You are accountable for one number above all: time to productivity for every GTM hire, everywhere.

This is a player/coach role, strategic and hands-on in equal measure. You will think about onboarding at global scale while writing curriculum, running cohorts and building the ramp dashboard yourself. You will also lead a small team of onboarding program managers in AMER and EMEA and set the standard that APAC delivers against.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Turn the current onboarding program into one global system, deciding what is standard in every region and what each region adapts

- Design the cohort model and delivery capacity to absorb a doubling of GTM headcount in 2027 with quality intact, including where AI lets a small team run a large program

- Own ramp reporting and a common ramp standard for every role, find where ramp slips by role, region and cohort, and change the program to fix it

- Partner with Sales Productivity to connect AE ramp milestones to pipeline generation and attainment

- Own the architecture for role-specific tracks across AEs, BDRs, CSMs, Legal Engineers, LEPS and Solutions Architects, and build the most important ones yourself

- Own frontline manager onboarding and the everboarding curriculum that keeps tenured reps current as our product, pricing and methodology change

- Own LMS strategy, the move to an AI-native LMS, certification infrastructure and the content system

- Lead, coach and develop the onboarding program managers in AMER and EMEA and the contractors who support delivery

- Partner with our APAC enablement lead so hires in Sydney get the same program as everyone else

WHAT YOU HAVE

- 8+ years of experience in enablement, onboarding, learning and development, or GTM program leadership at a high-growth technology company, ideally including time in a sales seat

- 2+ years managing a team (small teams count), with people you developed and held to a clear standard

- Recent hands-on experience building and delivering onboarding curriculum, certifications or ramp programs yourself

title: Founders Associate (Business Development)
description:
ABOUT TACTO

Tacto builds the procurement intelligence platform for manufacturers. AI agents work through order data and part drawings, find savings and automate manual work, so buyers can focus on strategy.

- 400+ manufacturers run more than $40 billion in purchasing volume on Tacto

- Founded in Munich; our US team sits in Chicago

- $65M+ raised from Sequoia and Index Ventures

OUR MISSION AT TACTO

We help American manufacturing win, starting with procurement.

America is reindustrializing: new plants are going up, supply chains are being rebuilt, and a $3 trillion manufacturing base is reinventing itself right now. Every physical product starts as bits, a design, a drawing and a tolerance, and ends as atoms when it comes off the line. Between the two sits the step that decides whether it gets built well: the perfect buy, sourcing every part from the right supplier, in the right quality, at the right cost and in time. More than half of a product’s cost comes from suppliers, yet at most manufacturers this step still runs on spreadsheets and email. Tacto gives procurement teams the AI to make the perfect buy on every part.

YOUR ROLE

You open the conversations with the manufacturers that build America, as our first full-time business development hire in the US.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

We entered the US this year and are building the team in Chicago. Procurement is where manufacturers turn reindustrialization into margin, and thousands of them have never heard of us yet. As our Founders Associate (Business Development), you build our first US pipeline: you reach procurement and supply chain leaders, find out what makes them say yes and turn it into the playbook that our next 20 BDRs will run. You work with our US leadership team every day.

WHY YOUR ROLE MATTERS

- You are first. You open the US market for Tacto. Every call you make shapes how America gets to know us.

- You write the playbook. The scripts, templates and sales material you build are what everyone after you will run.

- You learn GTM from the people who built it. You work daily with a leadership team that already built a category leader in Europe.

- You grow as fast as you deliver. After at least 6 to 12 months in business development, you shape your next step (see your career path below).

WHAT THIS ROLE IS AND ISN’T

- Hands on: You are on the phone, in inboxes and on LinkedIn every day. After two weeks of onboarding, including our cold call academy, you are live.

- Not a finished machine: There is no playbook yet. You test what works and build it as you go.

- Not a remote role: You build this in person with the team in our Chicago office, five days a week.

- The deal: Bring drive and discipline, and we give you a seat on the US founding team and a career path you shape yourself.

YOUR FIRST 3 MONTHS

- Weeks 1 to 2, fast onboarding: Business development onboarding with our cold call academy, product onboarding and an introduction to Tacto’s culture.

- From week 3, full outreach: You cold call every day, follow up on sendouts and events, and book your first own discovery calls.

- Week 6, ramp complete: From here, you work toward a clear monthly pipeline target.

- Month 3: You consistently hold 5+ discovery calls per week, we have a clear answer on cold calling as a channel, and the first version of the US BDR playbook is written.

YOUR CAREER PATH

After at least 6 to 12 months in business development, you shape your path:

1. Closing: Full-cycle Account Executive, later sales team lead.

2. Leadership: BDR team lead US, building and coaching the next BDRs on the playbook you wrote.

3. Generalist: A broader GTM role as the US organization grows.

YOUR TASKS

- Open the US market: As our first business development hire, you build our pipeline with the manufacturers that make this country run.

- Own the prospecting pipeline: From identifying to converting new leads, you proactively reach decision-makers in procurement and supply chain by phone, email

description:
Du hast noch nie im Vertrieb gearbeitet? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.
⚠️ WICHTIG: Aus Effizienzgründen werden nur Onlinebewerbungen über unsere Karriereseite und KEINE Bewerbungen per Post, E-Mail oder Telefon angenommen.
Standort: Remote | Vollzeit, Montag bis Freitag | 3 bis 4 Präsenztermine pro Jahr: jeweils 1 Woche Bootcamp in Wörgl, Tirol
Die Tunymedia GmbH ist eine stark wachsende Digitalagentur. Wir generieren für über 500 Handwerksbetriebe, Küchenstudios und Einrichtungshäuser im D-A-CH-Raum Anfragen und neue Kunden. Wir sind ein Team von über 40 Kolleginnen und Kollegen.
Für unser Vertriebsteam suchen wir Leute, die selbst etwas aufbauen wollen und keine Erfahrung mitbringen müssen. Ob du aus dem Handwerk kommst, aus der Gastro, dem Handel oder aus einem Job, in dem du mehr bewegen wolltest:
Das Fachwissen bringen wir dir bei. Was man nicht lernen kann, ist dein Wille, mehr aus dir zu machen.
Über den Job:
Als Vertriebsmitarbeiter (m/w/d) telefonierst du mit Inhabern von Handwerksbetrieben, Küchenstudios und Einrichtungshäusern und findest heraus, wo es gerade hakt: Fehlen Kunden, fehlen Mitarbeiter oder laufen die Abläufe nicht rund? Dann prüfst du, ob wir helfen können und ob beide Seiten zusammenpassen.
Jedes Gespräch läuft anders. Das ist Kaltakquise im besten Sinn: Du lernst schnell, wie man Menschen wirklich abholt.
Dein Weg: vom Quereinstieg zu mehr Verantwortung:
1. Ankommen: Du gehst die Schulungen durch, wirst eingearbeitet, lernst die Skripte und hörst zu.
2. Erste Gespräche: Du führst deine ersten eigenen Gespräche und bekommst Call-Reviews mit direktem Feedback dazu.
3. Eigenständig arbeiten: Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich.
Was dich bei uns erwartet:

• Klare Struktur: Du hast von Anfang an einen festen Ansprechpartner und einen klaren Fahrplan.

• Tägliche 1:1-Schulung: Wir analysieren schwierige Gespräche gemeinsam, hören live mit und geben dir direkt Feedback.

• Teamgefühl trotz Remote: Morgen-Huddle um 7:30 Uhr, Midday-Huddle um 13 Uhr und Roleplays im Team.

• Transparenz: Du erfährst, was aus deinen Terminen wird und wie sich deine Zahlen entwickeln.

• Offene Kommunikation: Bei uns kannst du sagen, was dich stört. Wir finden Lösungen.

• Kein Rädchen im System: Du bist Teil des Teams und kannst wirklich etwas bewirken.

• Entwicklung: Qualifier oder Teamleiter sind möglich

Das verdienst du:

• Fixgehalt als sichere Basis: Du startest mit einem festen Gehalt ab 36.000 € brutto im Jahr, je nach Qualifikation ist eine Überzahlung möglich. So kannst du dich voll auf deinen Einstieg konzentrieren.

• Provision auf deine Ergebnisse: Was du leistest, siehst du auch auf deiner Abrechnung. Wer mehr rausholt, verdient mehr.

• Mehr als Geld: Du lernst, überzeugend zu sprechen, mit Ablehnung umzugehen und dich selbst zu organisieren. Das bringt dich auch außerhalb des Jobs weiter.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Du telefonierst mit Entscheidern aus dem Handwerk und der Einrichtungsbranche und führst Bedarfsgespräche.

• Du vereinbarst Termine für unser Vertriebsteam.

• Du arbeitest mit klaren Kennzahlen und Zielen und analysierst deine Gespräche selbst.

• Du nimmst an Trainings, Reviews und Roleplays teil.

Requirements
Das bringst du mit:

• Lernbereitschaft: Du willst dich verbessern und bist bereit, dafür mehr zu geben als nötig.

• Standhaftigkeit: Ein Nein bringt dich nicht aus dem Konzept. Du bleibst offen für das nächste gute Gespräch.

• Zielorientierung: Du magst Ziele, Zahlen und Wettbewerb und willst dich daran messen.

• Ehrlichkeit und Kommunikation: Du sagst offen, was los ist, und nimmst Feedback an, auch wenn es direkt ist.

• Commitment: Wenn du dich für etwas entscheidest, ziehst du es durch.

• Reisebereitschaft: Du kommst 3- bis 4-mal im Jahr für jeweils 1 Woche zum Bootcamp nach Wörgl.

• Rahmen: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, ruhiger Arbeitsplatz zu Hause mit stabilem Internet, Vollzeit von Montag bis Freitag.

title: Model Policy Manager, Emerging AI Misuse
description:
About the Team

The Model Policy team within OpenAI’s Safety Systems organization defines how increasingly capable AI models should behave in real-world settings. We turn research on emerging risks into model behavior policies, evaluations, and safeguards.

About the Role

As AI systems become more capable, the same advances that expand their legitimate uses can also lower barriers to harm. Emerging misuse risks range from AI assistance with conventional weapons development and the misuse of AI-enabled robotics to fraud, impersonation, and other forms of abuse that people can carry out at scale using AI agents. You’ll build threat models for how people could misuse AI in digital and physical settings, assess what access to AI changes in practice, and use that evidence to define how models should respond.

This role is based in San Francisco. We offer relocation support and work from the office three days a week, with optional work from home on Thursdays and Fridays.

In this role, you will:

- Build and update threat models as capabilities evolve. Assess what people could plausibly do, what expertise and resources they would need, and how AI changes those barriers.

- Define when models should help, limit assistance, or refuse in situations where the same capability has legitimate and harmful uses.

- Turn expert safety judgment into instructions, training examples, and evaluations that teach models when to help, when to limit assistance, and when to refuse.

- Turn threat models into evaluation scenarios and grading guidance. Analyze model outputs, red-team findings, and deployment data to identify where models enable misuse or block legitimate work.

- Partner with research, engineering, security, and product teams to apply findings to model training, deployment decisions, and monitoring.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have hands-on experience building, testing, or assessing dual-use technologies, or a track record of threat modeling grounded in how people use and misuse real systems.

- Demonstrate deep practical experience in one relevant domain and the judgment to know when to bring in experts from others.

- Are able to assess whether a capability demonstrated in a test materially changes what someone could do outside it.

- Can translate technical evidence and uncertainty into clear policy boundaries and measurable evaluation criteria.

- Have experience analyzing gold sets, evaluation results, and training data to spot inconsistent human labels, assess how annotator disagreement affects measured performance, and decide what to investigate next.

- Are comfortable working hands-on with model data and evaluation results, including inspecting examples, analyzing failure patterns, assessing data quality, and distinguishing policy failures from grader, model, or system failures.

- Use empirical evidence to develop and refine safety policies and safeguards.

- Work well across disciplines and revises their judgment as capabilities and evidence change.

- Enjoy fast-paced, collaborative research environments where priorities shift as models, evidence, and risks change.

Relevant Publications

- Introducing the Model Spec https://openai.com/index/introducing-the-model-spec/

- Safety at every step https://openai.com/safety/
